recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-33006 after considering the explicit implementation commits and later FHIR-35863 harmonization; adding or rewriting source would be redundant and would not improve implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-33006 was a Published/Persuasive PA R5 change request to update EpisodeOfCare.diagnosis.condition to CodeableReference so a diagnosis can be represented as either a Condition reference or a CodeableConcept, with an example binding to the value set used by Condition.code.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by August 8, 2022 source commits 1e7af11fdd06, 65d8bfd85126, and b412b43a95c0. Those commits changed EpisodeOfCare.diagnosis.condition from Reference to CodeableReference, added the condition-code example binding, and updated the EpisodeOfCare diagnosis search parameters for the reference and concept branches.
additional_context: EpisodeOfCare is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/episodeofcare/structuredefinition-EpisodeOfCare.xml and source/episodeofcare/bundle-EpisodeOfCare-search-params.xml current build-scope source. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-35863 harmonized EpisodeOfCare.diagnosis with Encounter in commit 084c723e1409; it changed surrounding wording, cardinalities, and search parameter names while retaining the CodeableReference model required by FHIR-33006.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current StructureDefinition has CodeableReference targeting Condition with an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-code, and the search parameter bundle exposes both EpisodeOfCare.diagnosis.condition.concept and .reference.

related_jiras.note: Later PA harmonization of EpisodeOfCare.diagnosis changed surrounding definitions/cardinalities and search parameter names while preserving FHIR-33006's CodeableReference decision.
Encounter reason/diagnosis harmonization context that FHIR-35863 used for EpisodeOfCare alignment.
